title: Persona (BABOK v3 §10.43 — SP1)
description: An archetype of a person who does or receives the business processes. It comes from identified stakeholders and elicitation evidence. It is not an invented character.

name.description: The name that the BPMN models use as a lane

stakeholders.description: The stakeholders that this persona represents (STK-*)

evidence.description: A source that you can verify: interview, observation or document
